gloss: to address (a letter), to direct at

definitions.explanation: To write a recipient's name on a letter or package.
To assign something to a specific purpose or person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{田中|たなか}さん{宛|あ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: To send a letter addressed to Mr. Tanaka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{山田|やまだ}さん{宛|あ}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I sent the package addressed to Ms. Yamada.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宛名|あてな}→宛名：03995_atena⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I write the addressee's name before sending the letter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{宛|あ}てる。
⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{宛|あ}てる。
⟦{休日|きゅうじつ}→休日：03028_kyuujitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{宛|あ}てた。
examples.english: I devoted my day off to preparing for the trip.

notes:
{宛|あ}てる means to address (a letter) or to allocate/direct something toward a purpose.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を and に particles

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手紙|てがみ}を～{宛|あ}てに{送|おく}る: to send a letter addressed to ~
- {時間|じかん}を～に{宛|あ}てる: to allocate time to ~
- {資金|しきん}を～に{宛|あ}てる: to allocate funds to ~

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {宛先|あてさき}: address, recipient (on mail)
- {宛名|あてな}: addressee's name
- ～{宛|あて}: addressed to ~ (suffix)

NOTE:
Don't confuse with {当|あ}てる (to hit, to apply) or {充|あ}てる (to assign, to fill a role).
